comparison.objective: Candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs in a shell; record carries a microscope using only its arm and base.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests precision impact tooling and fragment pickup; record tests safe bimanual support and transport while avoiding fragile forbidden grasp regions. Specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, containment, retention, and no damage; record title imposes safe grasp regions, but its body omits detailed placement and threshold criteria.
comparison.reason: Safe transport by prescribed support points is different from contact-driven fracture at recessed inserts.
